title: Scalar transport of common additive etale augmentation representatives
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U any open family, I an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of its lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], and c a canonical resolution comparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Let mu(r) be a supplied sheaf endomorphism for every global structural section r whose component on each etale object W multiplies a section x by the pullback of r to W. Fix n,r and global and coefficient cycles s,z with total cycles t_alpha,t_beta satisfying the two augmentation component equations and equal total classes of [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization]. There exist cycles s_prime,z_prime and total cycles t_alpha_prime,t_beta_prime satisfying the same three equations, such that c([s_prime])=H(mu(r))(c([s])) and [z_prime]=r times [z] in ordinary unit Cech homology [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change].

source.place: Theorem 59.22.4, separated affine cover proof; Tags 01EQ and 01FD, augmented double-complex construction and naturality.

proof.text: Construct s_prime using cyclesMap of the actual global descent map, z_prime as r smul z, and both total cycles using cyclesMap of the actual total descent map. Apply the two cochain-level augmentation identities and cyclesMap_i to prove the new augmentation equations. Apply homology projection naturality to transport equality of total classes. Apply the proved canonical global-map naturality lemma for the sheaf-cohomology identity. Linearity of the ModuleCat homology projection proves the coefficient scalar identity. No representative is chosen from an unproved existence statement.

proof_origin.place: Scalar case of actual augmented double-complex functoriality; cyclesMap and homology projection naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem additiveCech_scalar_transport
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (μ : Γ(X, ⊤) → (X.etaleAdditiveSheaf ⟶ X.etaleAdditiveSheaf))
    (hμ : ∀ r (W : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : X.etaleAdditiveSheaf.obj.obj W),
      (μ r).hom.app W x =
        ULift.up ((show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from x.down) *
          (show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from W.unop.hom.appTop r)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (c : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison X.etaleAdditiveSheaf I)
    (n : ℕ) (r : Γ(X, ⊤))
    (s : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n)
    (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
    (tα tβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n)
    (hα : (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tα =
      additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s))
    (hβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tβ = additiveCechBeta U I n
      ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z))
    (ht : (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tα =
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tβ) :
    ∃ (s' : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n)
      (z' : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
      (tα' tβ' : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n),
      (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tα' =
        additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s') ∧
      (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tβ' = additiveCechBeta U I n
        ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z') ∧
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tα' =
        (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tβ' ∧
      c.globalEquiv n ((additiveCechGlobal I).homologyπ n s') =
        Sheaf.H.map (μ r) n (c.globalEquiv n ((additiveCechGlobal I).homologyπ n s)) ∧
      (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homologyπ n z' =
        r • (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homologyπ n z
